def priority(item, remaining):
    new_rem = remaining - item
    # Perfect fit is optimal
    if new_rem < 1e-9:
        return 1e9
    
    # Base: Best Fit (minimize remainder)
    score = -new_rem
    
    # Reward closing bins aggressively to reduce active count
    if new_rem < 0.03:
        score += 200.0 * (0.03 - new_rem)
    
    # Penalize "dead zones" where space is too small for typical items but not closed
    # Typical online distributions have many small items, so <0.1 is risky if not near 0
    elif new_rem < 0.15:
        # Steep penalty for fragments that are hard to utilize
        score -= 5.0 / (new_rem + 0.001)
        
    # Bonus for keeping large flexible spaces (>0.6) which can accept almost any item
    elif new_rem > 0.6:
        score += 0.2 * new_rem
        
    # Slight penalty for mid-range remainders (0.3-0.5) which are less flexible than large ones
    # and don't contribute to closing bins
    elif 0.3 < new_rem < 0.5:
        score -= 0.05
        
    return score
